thread:
Maria (CS): Renewal popped for BlueEdge today. Procurement is holding signature until three things: vendor-signed pen-test, SOC2 evidence, and confirmation that SSO + KMS are fully onboarded. Upsell discount contingent on completion.
Liam (Account Exec): Ugh, ok. Which of those do we actually have?
Tom (Onboarding): SOC2 frag is in our portal (public link) but they want the redacted vendor-signed pen-test PDF. SSO is configured but only in staging. KMS has keys but rotation/audit not finished.
Maria (CS): Procurement also wants invoice mapped to the legal entity "BlueEdge Inc." and PO# BE-2024-78. Legal won't e-sign if the contract entity != invoice entity.
Sophie (Legal): I can prepare an amendment referencing PO BE-2024-78 allowing provisional signature pending entity docs. However Legal needs confirmation the pen-test PDF was uploaded to procurement. Please attach the PDF and confirm.
Liam (Account Exec): I asked their security lead for the PDF 20m ago. Pinged again.
DocuSignBot: Envelope EN-9003 created by Sophie (Legal) for BlueEdge 1 awaiting signature from "CFO - BlueEdge Inc."
Tom (Onboarding): Potential short unblock: we can mark KMS as "operational=limited" in the onboarding tracker to indicate keys provisioned + KMS endpoint reachable, with rotation scheduled in 72h. Would procurement accept that as proof?
Maria (CS): Procurement said a provisional onboarding state + a concrete timeline + a named infra contact is acceptable. I'll ask them for the infra contact now. Reminder: discount window is 6 days from renewal notice.
Liam (Account Exec): I'll escalate to their CFO and ask for the signed PO and pen-test PDF. If I don't hear back in 2 hours I'll call.
Maria (CS): Tom, can you add exact dates to the tracker and link it here?
Tom (Onboarding): Done. SSO prod go-live 48h post role-accept, KMS minimal operational in 72h, full rotation + audit complete in 5 business days. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ONB/BLUE-42
Sophie (Legal): Amendment draft attached to envelope EN-9003. Clause allows provisional signature until entity docs (W-9/registration) arrive. Legal will hold execution if entity mismatch remains.
Liam (Account Exec): Update: CFO acknowledged and said accounting needs the vendor-signed PDF before they can sign the PO. They've given a named contact: sarah.infra@blueedge.com. I'm sending the IAM invite again.
Maria (CS): Great. I'll upload any artifacts to the onboarding checklist and notify procurement.
Tom (Onboarding): IAM role re-sent. If Sarah accepts today, we can do the KMS minimal flip and move SSO to prod within 48h.
Liam (Account Exec): If we get signatures and PDF within the 6-day window, discount holds. If not, discount reverts to standard renewal terms. I'll keep chasing.
Maria (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks team, will follow up with procurement and post updates here.
